1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 6 m de altura, con hojas simples, flores solitarias, pequeñas, de color rojizo y fruto en drupa, dulce y jugoso; es comestible. Malpighiaceae, Malpighia urens.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrubby plant reaching up to 6 m in height, with simple leaves, solitary small flowers of reddish color, and sweet and juicy fruit in drupe; it is edible. Malpighiaceae, Malpighia urens.
